topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Ran into an old friend today, or at least, that's what I thought. Some folks have a knack for just disappearing, like the trail they left was never really there to begin with. But I can't shake the times we had, the late-night secrets whispered under the cover of darkness. Met her today, in a coffee shop that probably wasn't even around back then. She looked right at me, but her eyes were empty, like she never knew me. Tried to play it cool, asked about the old days, but it was clear I was just a stranger. Some ties, they say, are unbreakable. But time, it’s a ruthless thing. Still, I’ll hold onto those memories, even if she can’t.
